001package io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple;
002
003import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedElement;
004import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedObject;
005import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedPrimitive;
006import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.processor.ObjectProcessor;
007import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.PathResolver;
008import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigClosedException;
009import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.StructuredFileConfig;
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.nio.file.Path;
013import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
014
015/**
016 * A Simple Structured File Config for storing key/value pairs in a File
017 *
018 * @param <T> The type of the data being stored
019 *
020 * @version 5.1.0
021 * @since 3.9.0
022 */
023public class StructuredSimpleFileConfig<T> extends StructuredFileConfig<T> {
024    /**
025     * The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
026     *
027     * @since 3.0.0
028     */
029    protected final @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor;
030
031    /**
032     * Create a new StructuredSimpleFileConfig
033     *
034     * @param clazz     The class of the data being stored
035     * @param file      The file where data is being stored
036     * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
037     *
038     * @since 2.0.0
039     */
040    protected StructuredSimpleFileConfig(@NotNull Class<T> clazz, @NotNull Path file, @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
041        super(clazz, file, false);
042
043        this.processor = processor;
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Create a blank config file
048     *
049     * @return The config bytes
050     *
051     * @throws java.io.IOException On create error
052     * @since 1.0.0
053     */
054    @Override
055    protected byte @NotNull [] create() throws IOException {
056        if (this.closed) {
057            throw new ConfigClosedException();
058        }
059
060        return "\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
061    }
062
063    /**
064     * Load the config
065     *
066     * @param save Weather to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
067     *
068     * @throws java.io.IOException On load error
069     * @since 1.3.0
070     */
071    @Override
072    public void load(boolean save) throws IOException {
073        if (this.closed) {
074            throw new ConfigClosedException();
075        }
076
077        synchronized (SAVELOAD_LOCK) {
078            ParsedObject object = ParsedObject.create();
079
080            for (String line : new String(this.loadRaw(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).split("\n")) {
081                line = line.trim();
082                if (line.isBlank()) {
083                    continue;
084                }
085
086                String[] splitLine = line.split("=", 3);
087
088                String path = splitLine[0];
089                String type = splitLine[1].toUpperCase();
090                ParsedPrimitive.PrimitiveType primitiveType = ParsedPrimitive.PrimitiveType.valueOf(type);
091                String value = splitLine[2];
092
093                ParsedPrimitive element = ParsedPrimitive.from(ParsedPrimitive.fromString(value).to(primitiveType));
094
095                PathResolver.updateElement(object, path, element, true);
096            }
097
098            this.config = this.processor.toObject(object, this.clazz);
099
100            if (save) {
101                this.save();
102            }
103        }
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Save the config to bytes
108     *
109     * @return The config bytes
110     *
111     * @throws java.io.IOException On save error
112     * @since 1.0.0
113     */
114    @Override
115    protected byte @NotNull [] saveRaw() throws IOException {
116        if (this.config == null) {
117            return this.create();
118        }
119
120        ParsedObject object = this.processor.toElement(this.config).asObject();
121
122        StringBuilder data = new StringBuilder();
123
124        for (String key : PathResolver.getKeys(object, false)) {
125            ParsedElement element = PathResolver.resolveElement(object, key);
126            if (element != null) {
127                if (key.contains("=")) {
128                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Key cannot contain '='");
129                }
130                data.append(key).append("=").append(element.asPrimitive().getType().name()).append("=").append(!element.asPrimitive().isNull() ? element.asPrimitive().get().toString() : "null").append("\n");
131            }
132        }
133
134        return data.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * A builder class for creating new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.StructuredSimpleFileConfig}s
139     *
140     * @param <T> The type of the data to be stored
141     *
142     * @version 5.0.0
143     * @since 4.0.0
144     */
145    public static class Builder<T> {
146        /**
147         * The class of the data being stored
148         *
149         * @since 4.0.0
150         */
151        protected final @NotNull Class<T> clazz;
152
153        /**
154         * The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
155         *
156         * @since 4.0.0
157         */
158        protected @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor;
159
160        /**
161         * The file to use
162         *
163         * @since 4.0.0
164         */
165        protected @NotNull Path file;
166
167        /**
168         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.StructuredSimpleFileConfig} builder
169         *
170         * @param clazz The class of the data being stored
171         * @param file  The file to use
172         *
173         * @since 4.0.0
174         */
175        public Builder(@NotNull Class<T> clazz, @NotNull Path file) {
176            this.clazz = clazz;
177
178            this.processor = new ObjectProcessor.Builder().build();
179
180            this.file = file;
181        }
182
183        /**
184         * Get the class of the data being stored
185         *
186         * @return The class of the data being stored
187         *
188         * @since 4.0.0
189         */
190        public @NotNull Class<T> getClazz() {
191            return this.clazz;
192        }
193
194        /**
195         * Get the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
196         *
197         * @return The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
198         *
199         * @since 4.0.0
200         */
201        public @NotNull ObjectProcessor getProcessor() {
202            return this.processor;
203        }
204
205        /**
206         * Set the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
207         *
208         * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
209         *
210         * @return Self for chaining
211         *
212         * @since 4.0.0
213         */
214        public @NotNull Builder<T> setProcessor(@NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
215            this.processor = processor;
216            return this;
217        }
218
219        /**
220         * Get the file to use
221         *
222         * @return The file to use
223         *
224         * @since 4.0.0
225         */
226        public @NotNull Path getFile() {
227            return this.file;
228        }
229
230        /**
231         * Set the file to use
232         *
233         * @param file The file to use
234         *
235         * @return Self for chaining
236         *
237         * @since 4.0.0
238         */
239        public @NotNull Builder<T> setFile(@NotNull Path file) {
240            this.file = file;
241            return this;
242        }
243
244        /**
245         * Creating a new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.StructuredSimpleFileConfig}
246         *
247         * @return A new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.StructuredSimpleFileConfig}
248         *
249         * @since 4.0.0
250         */
251        public @NotNull StructuredSimpleFileConfig<T> build() {
252            return new StructuredSimpleFileConfig<>(this.clazz, this.file, this.processor);
253        }
254    }
255}
